loop:
  lw   x5, 0(x1)
  add  x6, x5, x2
  addi x1, x1, 4
  bne  x1, x3, loop

loop:                     # unrolled twice
  lw   x5, 0(x1)
  lw   x7, 4(x1)
  add  x6, x5, x2
  add  x8, x7, x2
  addi x1, x1, 8
Unrolling duplicates a safe loop body. The existing DAG scheduler can then reorder the larger block to hide more stalls.
